title: Agent control development build
availability: Local private build; not included in the published 1.6.0 download or API snapshot.

features.title: Capability readiness
features.description: Discover device identity, Android access, enabled features and exact readiness blockers.

features.title: Expiring agent permissions
features.description: Grant individual capabilities on the phone for a bounded time and revoke active work.

features.title: Owner-started control sessions
features.description: Approve selected apps and a duration, with one controller, heartbeat expiry and a visible Stop control.

features.title: Durable action outcomes
features.description: Inspect operation state, safely reuse an idempotency key and reconcile interrupted or unknown outcomes.

features.title: Fresh screen context
features.description: Use Android-approved screen sharing or private screen capture; UI trees require a scoped private session.

features.title: Semantic element targeting
features.description: Find snapshot-bound elements by their labels, roles and state; protected fields are excluded.

features.title: Reviewed app actions
features.description: Review one app action or up to eight exact steps together. The private runtime checks each target and postcondition before continuing; changed or ambiguous targets stop the sequence.

features.title: Wait and verify
features.description: Check an explicit postcondition after an action, and distinguish input dispatch from an observed result.

features.title: Branded questions and approvals
features.description: Review the authenticated agent identity and exact action, answer a question, decline or cancel.

features.title: Supported app drafts
features.description: Open reviewed links and apps, prepare calendar or message drafts, and leave final completion to the owner.

features.title: REST and MCP tools
features.description: Use the same scoped command path through the additive v2 API and the private build’s MCP endpoint.

features.title: Selected notification replies
features.description: Read only owner-allowlisted notification apps and approve a reply where that app exposes inline reply.

features.title: Selected files and sharing
features.description: Transfer bounded images, text, PDFs or audio and choose an agent from the Android Sharesheet.

features.title: Local reading and translation
features.description: Use local OCR, barcode recognition, speech output, supported on-device dictation and downloaded translation models.

features.title: Productivity assistance
features.description: Prepare appointments, timers, alarms, dialer and communications drafts through supported Android intents.

features.title: Native local workflows
features.description: Approve a bounded workflow with a button, interval, charging or geofence trigger and native button/status/help template. Android may defer background checks.

features.title: Device diagnostics
features.description: Inspect lock, power, storage, network and permission readiness, with Android access links on the phone.

features.title: Bounded camera and help sessions
features.description: Approve time-limited JPEG monitoring with viewer-only credentials, or a help button that queues signed alerts to approved recipients. No continuous audio/video or emergency guarantee.

features.title: Explicit device routing
features.description: Register private-network devices and verify their stable identity before routing a tool call. No silent fallback to another phone.

features.title: Specialist device adapters
features.description: Use barcode images, reviewed Bluetooth scans/GATT operations, bounded USB bulk transfers and owner-started NFC reads where hardware and permissions allow.

verification.unitTests: Both private and limited variants; see repository test reports.
verification.deviceAcceptance: Targeted fixture checks; hardware and OEM acceptance remains feature-specific.
